name: Hessian Multi-Dimensional Vascular Suture Scanner
description: An uncompromising decomposition reactor designed to slaughter structural micro-differentials. Ignorantly bypassing mere optical points or corners, this grinder hunts for the 'Spatial Vascular Structures' (Ridges, Silk fibers, Veins). Authentic facial curvature and draped fabrics possess a flawless, unbroken second-order anatomical slope in physical space. When Midjourney or malicious Inpainting attempts to crudely smooth disparate meat and bone together into a seamless synthetic joint, it horrifically mangles the second-order mathematical curve. A swipe from this Matrix instantly exposes these atrocious microscopic spiral-fractures buried beneath the waxy, synthetic veneer.
algorithm: 2nd-Order Derivative Topology Ridge Fracture Matrix (Hessian Extraction)
mechanism: Abandoning shallow chromatic perception, Hessian violently tunnels through space into the 2nd-Order Derivative bedrock (capturing photonic velocity acceleration). Take two pixels spliced from a jacket onto a brick wall: The amateur eye perceives seamless integration. But when computing the photonic 'Acceleration' with Hessian, a catastrophic anomaly detonates! It violently lurches like a racecar brutally careening off a cliff because the color-acceleration was idiotically stretched and warped by an amateur editor. Hessian skins the entire canvas, exposing a raw vascular web. Wherever this web is grotesquely swollen, mangled, or severed right at a suspected border—the guillotine drops.
parameters: Geometry Assessor: Local 2nd-Order Partial Derivative Matrix [d^2I/dx^2, d^2I/dxdy...], Forensic Core: Eigenvalue Ridge/Tube Thresholds
accuracy: Fiercely Fluid Combatant (76-85%) - An unyielding executioner obliterating every desperate AI algorithm attempting to mathematically forge physical skin pores or cascading fabric folds.
source: Physical Topographical Ridge Accelerations & Derivative Spatial Mechanics
useCase: Rains absolute hellfire down upon algorithmic 'Beauty' masterpieces where a model's forehead or jawline was maliciously carved down via Warp/Liquify witchcraft. The visual facade appears seductively smooth, but the raw Hessian vascular core is screaming with torn, exploding pixel coordinates.

references.title: Frangi, A. F., et al. (1998). Multiscale vessel enhancement filtering. MICCAI.

strengths:
• Artillery shell that completely bypasses fraudsters attempting to smother their crime scene in hostile, synthetic 'Noise' spray. Because the Hessian Matrix exclusively tracks the 2nd-order derivatives of MACRO-structures (craters, thick folds), surface grain fails entirely to deceive its hunt.
• Terrifyingly hyper-sensitive in unmasking ANY 'Liquify' waist-slimming or chin-carving application. The optical warp is silky smooth, but mathematically it violently eviscerates the pixel's intrinsic curved eigenvalue down to its cellular ridge.
limitations:
• The executioner's blade completely splinters into irrelevance (spamming Null verdicts) if blindly swung at a featurelessly flat sky, an utterly blank painted wall, or ultra-smooth gloss, purely because there is ZERO structural curvature to throttle.
• Catastrophically smothered and gagged by barbaric lossy JPEG compression algorithms; when the pixel grid is blasted into microscopic bricks, all 2nd-order derivatives are wiped to a smooth, sterile zero.
